capabilities: Convert supported files (PDF, docx, pptx, xlsx, images, HTML, EPUB, audio) to Markdown via right-click or command palette
Save converted Markdown next to the source file or in a custom folder
Embed source images as base64 data in the output Markdown
Run AI-powered OCR on scanned PDFs through markitdown-ocr with an OpenAI vision model
Send PDFs to Azure Document Intelligence for higher-accuracy text extraction
extras: Desktop only (uses Node.js child_process, cannot run on Obsidian Mobile). Audio conversion requires ffmpeg. AI OCR and Azure features send data to third-party services and are billed per use; API keys are stored in the vault at .obsidian/plugins/docdrop/data.json.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert documents like PDFs, Word files, or spreadsheets into Markdown notes locally inside the vault.

relations.evidence: converts documents, spreadsheets, images, and more to Markdown using Microsoft's MarkItDown CLI tool
markitdown-ocr is a separately-installed plugin that adds AI-powered OCR
Azure AI Document Intelligence is a paid Microsoft Azure cloud service that uses AI to extract text from PDFs
it uses a vision-capable language model (such as OpenAI GPT-4o) to read text from images

summary: Document converter that turns PDFs, Office files, images, and other formats into Markdown files in the vault using Microsoft's MarkItDown CLI.
